headline: Palantine Surge Holds While Mercy Front Quickens
war_summary: Three hours have sharpened the picture at Palantine Berm, now counting ten changes in two hours and twenty-seven in the day about The Pippeli Stones and Vendett, listed at two Warden, four Colonial and one neutral with the latest wire at the cutoff. Marban Hollow holds steady at four changes in two hours and twenty in the day centred on Checkpoint Bua, standing three Warden, four Colonial and one neutral. Linn Mercy has moved to the fore with four late changes about Outwich Ranch and Lathair alongside very heavy two-hour losses, while Nevish Line adds three changes about Grief Mother with similarly heavy losses. By contrast the Weathered Expanse and Mooring County have gone quiet in the last two hours despite sixty-three and thirty-six changes in the day, and Kuura Strand and Stlican Shelf show no fresh flips. Callahan's Passage reports sharp accelerating losses without a recorded flip.
